== Description ==

[[Jack Douglass]] (centre, black Star Wars T-shirt and glasses) at the foreground table, with [[Chris Wirfs]] (floral shirt) playing [[Ryan Jellison]] (grey Summer League sweatshirt) at the table behind and [[Matt Scott]] (standing back left, black Nike track jacket) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025; other players unlabeled.
